description: Run multiple web searches in one call (parallel). Duplicate URLs across queries are removed automatically. Great for comparing topics, gathering multi-angle context, or fanning out sub-queries. Each query costs 1 credit.

freshness.description: Time filter: pd=past day pw=week pm=month py=year any=none (historical). Pass pd/pw/pm/py whenever the user asks for latest/current/recent results ("today", "this week", "latest", current year); omit or "any" for timeless or historical questions. The response footer echoes the filter that was applied.

num_results.description: Results (1–20, default 5). Note: >10 results uses 2 Serper credits.

queries.description: Search queries (1–10 items, each max 400 chars / 50 words).

name: search_many
